desc: Task 0 (Ideation): choose FFT self-convolution approach, analyze precision, memory, and pitfalls.
Task 1 (Implementation): single file combining fast I/O parse (handle N<3, wrapped lines, trailing whitespace), FFT self-convolution at length 2^21, and counting via `((g[2*S]-1)//2).sum()`.
Task 2 (Validation): samples verified (3, 5, 10); formula `(g[2B]-1)/2` re-derived; brute-force branch covers all small-N cases; bytes→int64 parse path has a `np.fromiter` fallback.
Task 3 (Performance/precision analysis): FFT length 2^21, values ≤ 10^6, float64 error ~1e-8 ≪ 0.5 so `np.rint` is exact; peak memory ~50 MB, runtime ~0.2–0.5 s for N = 10^6.
Task 4 (Contingency parity-split): not needed — current performance/memory are within limits.
